IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: MyPoint Credit Union provides its members with higher saving dividends, enhanced services, lower loan rates, and reduced service fees.
IRS990.MissionDesc: We are committed to working together to help our members achieve their financial goals, while being financially prudent to assure safety and soundness.
IRS990.Desc: MyPoint Credit Union provides its membership competitively priced deposit products. As of 12/31/24, the credit union held 31,255 savings accounts, 21,256 checking accounts, 3,067 money market accounts, 3,788 share certificates, and 1,241 IRA certificates in the amount of $132,571,203, $174,017,168, $69,624,470, $166,618,876 and $13,261,555respectively. In total, the credit union held 60,607, accounts in the amount of $556,093,272 with a membership of 27,340

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: MyPoint Credit Union provides its membership competitive consumer loan programs including vehicle loans, unsecured loans, and a business loan program to help our local small businesses. The credit union funded 2,370 new loans in the amount of $120,283,399 As of 12/31/2024, the credit union held 15,211 consumer and business loans in the amount of $253,266,938.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: MyPoint Credit Union offers a competitive mortgage loan program to make home ownership more affordable to its membership. In 2024, the credit union funded new real estate loans including 1st and 2nd trust deed mortgages and home equity lines of credit, in the amount of $82,830,504. As of 12/31/24, the credit union held the total of 1,773real estate loans in the amount of $262,340,441
